name: Precision Protocol / Precision Protocol 2 / Precision Protocol 3

values.meaning: Bonus Physical Damage on empowered attack
Increased Mixed Damage on delayed recast
values.binNote: No single bin row states 0.4-0.8 directly; CamilleQ#EmpoweredBonusDamage computes BonusDamage (which uses TADRatio=[0.2..0.4]) multiplied by QEmpoweredAmp=2, giving 0.4 to 0.8, matching the wiki's stated 40 to 80% AD.

values.meaning: portion of the delayed recast's total damage dealt as true damage
values.binNote: Bin's byLevel array continues past level 16 to 1.04/1.08 at levels 17-18, but the wiki explicitly states the percentage is capped at level 16 (100%), so levels 17-18 are recorded as 1.0 per the wiki text, disagreeing with the bin's uncapped values.

values.meaning: delay after the empowered attack before a recast doubles the damage
window during which Precision Protocol can be recast at no additional cost
duration of the bonus movement speed

mechanics.claim: Both casts of Precision Protocol reset Camille's basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: Both casts of Precision Protocol reset Camille's basic attack timer.

mechanics.claim: The cooldown does not start until the first empowered attack lands.
Neither the first empowered attack nor the recast can critically strike.
Both casts count as ability activations for on-cast effects such as Spellblade.
mechanics.quote: Both casts count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.

mechanics.claim: The recast becomes empowered (dealing the doubled/true-damage version) as long as it starts after the 1.5-second delay, even if the recast input was made earlier.
mechanics.quote: The second attack will also become empowered if it simply starts after the {{fd|1.5}}-second delay, even if the recast was consumed earlier.

mechanics.claim: On the delayed recast, the true damage portion is dealt just before the physical damage portion of the attack.
mechanics.quote: Is dealt just prior to the physical damage portion of the attack.

mechanics.claim: Camille can cast Tactical Sweep, Hookshot, or The Hextech Ultimatum during the empowered attack's windup without cancelling it.
mechanics.quote: '''Camille''' is able to cast {{ai|Tactical Sweep|Camille}}, {{ai|Hookshot|Camille}}, or {{ai|The Hextech Ultimatum|Camille}} during the windup of Precision Protocol's empowered attack without cancelling it.
